newsitem.title: USA: Enserch Exploration has new offshore output.
newsitem.headline: Enserch Exploration has new offshore output.

text.p: Enserch Exploration Inc has participated in three Gulf of Mexico continental shelf exploratory discoveries so far this year and expects to begin producing two of the wells in the next couple of months, chief executive Tom Hamilton told analysts.

On Eugene Island 107, the EI 1073 well was drilled to 17,350 feet and discovered 125 feet of natural gas pay from seven upper Miocene sands. Completion operations are under way and production is expected to begin in April after the well is tied back to the EI 107 facility, Hamilton said.
